thread:
marco: Heads-up: new org policy rolling out 2025-01-10T08:00:00Z that limits AWS STS session duration for cross-account roles to a max of 1 hour. This aims to reduce long-lived assume-role tokens used by tooling.

aya: Does this affect CI/CD and our deploy runners that assume cross-account roles?

marco: Yes. Any automation that currently requests longer-than-1h durations will start failing to assume roles after enforcement. Please update callers to either refresh tokens more frequently or use short-lived task roles where possible.

aya: Our ECS tasks use assume-role for s3 uploads with session-duration=43200. We'll need to change. Any suggested pattern?

marco: Recommended patterns: 1) Use task IAM roles attached to the compute (ECS task role / EKS pod IAM). 2) If you must assume a cross-account role, implement a refresh loop that re-assumes every 45m. 3) For CI, use OIDC federation from the provider with short sessions.

infra-oncall-bot: Automated scanner will run at enforcement and create tickets for principals that call AssumeRole with DurationSeconds > 3600.

dave: How do we find callers right now? Any quick queries?

marco: Quick query examples:
AWS CloudTrail (CloudWatch Logs Insights):
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.durationSeconds
| filter eventName = "AssumeRole" and requestParameters.durationSeconds > 3600
| sort @timestamp desc
```

AWS Config: look for iam-policy statements that allow sts:AssumeRole with conditions allowing long sessions.

aya: ETA for policy docs? Also, is there an outage window planned?

marco: Docs and migration guide published here: https://internal.redwood/security/aws-session-duration. No outage planned. Enforcement is gradual: 72h soft window (audit + tickets), then hard enforcement blocking requests with DurationSeconds > 3600. Enforcement start: 2025-01-10T08:00:00Z.

ops-bot: canary:iam-session-policy deploy succeeded 07:15 UTC :white_check_mark:

marco: If you need an exemption (rare), open an eng-security ticket with owner, justification, and expected remediation ETA. We'll grant only time-limited exceptions.

aya: Starting inventory of roles and CI jobs now. Will flag blockers here.

marco: Thanks. If any teams want help updating SDK callers (python/node) to refresh tokens, ping @infra-oncall and we'll pair. Closing thread.
